t: You're looking at St John the Baptist, usually just called St John's Hoxton, an Anglican parish church in the Hoxton area of Hackney. It was designed by Francis Edwards, an architect born in 1784 who died in 1857. Edwards worked across the Georgian and early Victorian periods, and did a great deal of his work in London, so this church sits within a much larger body of his buildings around the city. It remains a working parish church for the neighbourhood today.
